title: Onomasticon Lexicon
description: A reusable word list referenced by one or more pack slots via lexiconRefs. Kept separate from packs so a lexicon (e.g. 'common-western-given') can be shared across genres and lazy-loaded independently of pack metadata.

schemaVersion.description: Bump only on breaking changes to this schema.

id.description: Referenced by a pack's lexiconRefs map, e.g. 'elven-given'.

variants.description: Open vocabulary, e.g. 'masc'/'fem'/'neutral' or any pack-defined key. Omit entirely to match any variant filter.

weight.description: Relative selection weight among entries matching the requested variant.

tags.description: Optional finer-grained filtering (region, era, etc.) beyond variant.
